title: Isothermal Batch Reactor First-Order Decay
description: Foundational gPROMS dynamic model of an isothermal well-mixed batch reactor with first-order irreversible conversion A -> B and typed physical variables.
code:
DECLARE
  TYPE
    Concentration = 1.0 : 0.0 : 100.0 UNIT = "mol/L"
    ReactionRate  = 0.0 : -1000.0 : 1000.0 UNIT = "mol/(L*s)"
  END
END

MODEL IsothermalBatchReactor
  PARAMETER
    k AS REAL DEFAULT 0.25

  VARIABLE
    C_A AS Concentration
    C_B AS Concentration
    r   AS ReactionRate

  EQUATION
    r = k * C_A ;
    $C_A = -r ;
    $C_B = r ;
END

PROCESS BatchSimulation
  UNIT
    B101 AS IsothermalBatchReactor
  SET
    B101.k := 0.25 ;
  INITIAL
    B101.C_A := 5.0 ;
    B101.C_B := 0.0 ;
  SOLUTIONPARAMETERS
    ReportingInterval := 0.1 ;
    TotalTime := 20.0 ;
END

title: Tubular Plug-Flow Reactor Axial Dispersion PDE
description: Distributed-parameter gPROMS PDE model of a tubular plug-flow reactor with axial dispersion, first-order reaction, and Danckwerts inlet boundary condition.
code:
DECLARE
  TYPE
    Concentration = 1.0 : 0.0 : 100.0 UNIT = "mol/L"
  END
END

MODEL AxialDispersionPFR
  PARAMETER
    v    AS REAL DEFAULT 0.6
    D_ax AS REAL DEFAULT 0.015
    k    AS REAL DEFAULT 0.35
    C_in AS REAL DEFAULT 8.0

  DISTRIBUTION_DOMAIN
    Axial AS [ 0.0 : 1.0 ] N = 15

  VARIABLE
    C AS DISTRIBUTION(Axial) OF Concentration

  BOUNDARY
    C(0.0) = C_in ;

  EQUATION
    $C = -v * PARTIAL(C, Axial) + D_ax * PARTIAL(PARTIAL(C, Axial), Axial) - k * C ;
END

PROCESS TubularPfrSimulation
  UNIT
    T301 AS AxialDispersionPFR
  SET
    T301.v := 0.6 ;
    T301.D_ax := 0.015 ;
    T301.k := 0.35 ;
    T301.C_in := 8.0 ;
  INITIAL
    T301.C := 0.0 ;
  SOLUTIONPARAMETERS
    TotalTime := 8.0 ;
    TimeStep := 0.005 ;
END
